issues.description: Constructor parameter type mismatch for Developer.init(...): The problem statement and the template declare the initializer parameter monthsOfSwiftExperience as an optional Int? (expecting init(name: String, monthsOfSwiftExperience: Int?)). In the solution repository the Developer initializer is declared with a non-optional parameter monthsOfSwiftExperience: Int (init(name: String, monthsOfSwiftExperience: Int)). The solution's Client instantiates Developer with nil for monthsOfSwiftExperience, which is incompatible with the non-optional initializer in the solution. This contradiction will cause compilation errors for the provided solution and confuses students whether the initializer should accept nil.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the solution with the problem statement and template by changing the Developer initializer in Sources/DeveloperLib/Developer.swift to accept an optional parameter: init(name: String, monthsOfSwiftExperience: Int?). Inside the initializer assign the optional to the property and keep the print(self.swiftExperienceDescription()) call. This preserves the intended behavior and allows Client.swift to pass nil. Alternatively (less preferred), update all call sites to pass non-optional Int values, but the preferred fix is to accept Int? to match the specification.
